Synthesized productization, reusable IP, and commercialization into a commercial-engine thesis without repeating bullet metrics.

claim_ledger.claim_text: Owned Unify Consulting’s mandate to industrialize governed agentic AI, turning control-plane architecture and disciplined delivery operations into a productized commercial engine for regulated enterprise clients, with reusable IP and partner-enabled adoption extending from bespoke engagements to repeatable deployment pathways.

companion_unify_bullets_context.text:
- bul_unify_001: Architected a governed, policy-gated agent execution surface for enterprise AI workflows, establishing L0 route-policy dispatch, runtime gate verdict contracts, and proof-bundle lineage for reproducible, auditable agent traces.
- bul_unify_002: Drove CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization, pairing partner-facing deal support with usage-based subscription forecasting to expand enterprise workflow adoption.
- bul_unify_003: Delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows by combining runtime resilience controls and context engineering with disciplined evaluation-gate governance.
- bul_unify_004: Accelerated the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks through managed workflow orchestration and replayable runtime design across intake, validation, and production monitoring stages.
- bul_unify_005: Established cloud data and runtime integration patterns across Databricks Lakehouse, vector services, and API gateways, applying dense sparse exact retrieval design and provider egress governance for high-availability distributed execution.
- bul_unify_006: Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while advancing agentic platform productization and an operating model for agentic AI that converted delivery work into reusable, commercialized platform capability.
